node.statement: H-space law. The descended multiplication breve-mu is continuous, breve-mu(breve-e,breve-e)=breve-e, and the exact identities mu(J,U)=mu(U,J)=U imply breve-mu(breve-e,x)=x=breve-mu(x,breve-e). Hence both unit maps are literally the identity (and therefore basepoint-preserving homotopic to it by the constant homotopy), so (breve-calU,breve-e,breve-mu) is an H-space in the precise sense of def-h-space-left-inversion.
